subjects.label: Relaxing routine work
subjects.description: The feel of the game as calm repetitive labour: a morning coffee while sowing fields, chilling with a beer, the brain turning to mush, and the joke that it is a second job or slavery; not moods of tension, dread or immersion in a story.

subjects.label: Tractors, machinery and brands
subjects.description: The vehicles and implements themselves: named makes such as Ursus, Valtra or Zetor, a favourite tractor, the range of machines on offer and how they drive; not whether the farming as a whole is realistic or how the game looks.

subjects.label: Realism and real farming
subjects.description: Whether the simulation matches real agriculture and what it teaches about it: authentic or unrealistic detail such as log weights or missing irrigation, learning about farm economics and forestry, and the game standing in for a farming life or career; not graphical fidelity.

subjects.label: Production chains and farm economy
subjects.description: Running the farm as a business: production chains, which products earn most, managing money, contracts, sell points and deliveries; not the vehicles or the field work itself.

subjects.label: Crops and growing
subjects.description: The crops and what is done with them: grains, greenhouse vegetables and fruit, silage, growth times and the stages of cultivation such as irrigation; not animals, forestry or the machines used.

subjects.label: Livestock and animals
subjects.description: Keeping animals: cows, pigs, chickens and their eggs, bees, their pens and their products, including animals escaping; not crops or forestry.

subjects.label: Forestry and logging
subjects.description: Felling trees with the chainsaw, log weights, hauling and selling timber, and bugs with trees; not field crops or livestock.

subjects.label: Changes from the previous edition
subjects.description: How this edition compares with earlier entries in the same series and the next one due: what is new, whether it has evolved enough, and waiting for the next release; not comparisons with other games or genres.
